# FlatRedBall.InterpolationCore

The source of the `FlatRedBall.InterpolationCore` NuGet package (2025.4.22.1), which Gum depends on.
It lives inside the much larger FlatRedBall repository, so only its files are copied here, unchanged.

- Repository: https://github.com/vchelaru/FlatRedBall
- Commit: `33179768435be3cca8750e2ef1de7bc37c7443ab` (the package's repository commit)
- Path: `FRBDK/Glue/StateInterpolationPlugin/StateInterpolationPlugin/`
- Files: the thirteen whose types the package's assembly contains (Back through Sinusoidal, Instant,
  Tweener). The rest of that folder is the Glue editor plugin.
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`.
